row.body: A door key is kept with a cleaning bottle and a checklist that says the rooms were clear. The back asks for one more walk-through before reopening.
row.title: Clear on the first pass

sidecar.gloss: A completed clearance is followed by a request for another inspection.
sidecar.rival_reading: A program site might require a routine recheck after cleaning; the list does not say why it was closed.
